errors.evidence: The orange line shows 7.3% for 2019 and 6.8% for 2020, but the description incorrectly states the 6.8% value is for 2020 directly after 7.8% (2018), skipping 7.3% (2019). The value itself is correct, but the sequence is misleading.
The description omits the explicit label of the y-axis as 'Купувачи (в млрд.)', though it mentions the units are for buyers in billions.
The description does not explicitly mention the sharp jump of 5.4 percentage points from 2022 to 2023 in the orange line.
